stories.title: Who should regulate global AI? China makes a play for leadership
stories.summary: The AI world is moving at lightning speed – and the world is trying to figure out how to regulate this technology. China just made a big play to be the global leader.

stories.title: World Cup: Spain's homecoming heroes
stories.summary: A nation celebrates as Spain's World Cup champions come home to a hero's welcome.

stories.title: At Mississippi funeral, civil rights leaders call for justice for Nolan Wells, 18
stories.summary: The parents of Nolan Wells, who was found dead on Horn Island in Mississippi, will hold a funeral for the 19-year-old on Monday. Wells was with friends for the Fourth of July and did not return home.

stories.title: The war in Iran has left hundreds of U.S. diplomats in limbo
stories.summary: As the U.S-Iran war ramps up again, hundreds of diplomats are in limbo. The State Department drew down staffing due to Iran's attacks on Gulf states. It's unclear if they'll return to normal business.

stories.title: Artist Bill Fontana explores the world's hidden sounds
stories.summary: Sound artist Bill Fontana creates works that often show the hidden music of everyday environments. His new work amplifies still bells at the Grace Cathedral in San Francisco.

stories.title: Trump says Qatari-donated Air Force One will be 'maxed out,' raising questions
stories.summary: The White House says the newest plane to serve as Air Force One will soon be sent away for upgrades. That has renewed questions about the security features of the jet that was donated by Qatar.
